import sys, datetime, logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(message)s")
sys.path.insert(0,"scripts")
import fetch_bufr_obs as f
for dt in (datetime.datetime(2026,10,6,3), datetime.datetime(2026,10,6,9)):

    names=f.ogimet_list_files(dt)
    print("files:", names)
    if names:
        html=f.fetch_ogimet_html(dt)
        if html:
            o=f.parse_obs(html,dt); print("T",o["temp"],"SLP",o["slp"],"wind",o["wind_spd_ms"],"vis",o["visibility"])
